prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit white-washed courtyard with a pale tiled floor, an arched doorway at normal height, low stone steps and a waist-high wall, evenly lit by soft overcast light, shadows very soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, THREE people standing close side by side, shoulder to shoulder in a single row, with just enough spacing that every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back far enough that all three are visible from head to toe, the whole row filling the width of the tall frame, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in soft overcast daylight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Nigerian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter glowing on the cheekbones, bold shimmering gold and emerald eyeshadow blended out toward the temples, dramatic long lashes, sharply defined brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong glossy fuchsia-pink lip, a bright, joyful smile, soft rose-gold hair styled in an intricate fishtail braid, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large brass hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a silver small flared temple bell, a gold cube-shaped block, a silver ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single gold bracelet. Extremely long coffin nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; everything about her is at its extreme at once: a towering frame with endless legs, a colossal heavy bust wider than her shoulders, a waist cinched to an impossible minimum, enormous round hips and a high rounded rear, gigantic thick thighs pressed together, smooth glowing skin over soft full curves; her silhouette is an exaggerated hourglass that dominates the whole frame from head to toe; not thin, not boyish, not evenly proportioned; her head looks small above her body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Background & Lighting: each material glowing softly under the diffused light, the gentle light modelling every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
